exposure: type and volume of milk intake (exclusive human milk diet vs. mixed diet)
outcome: cumulative volume of mother's own milk (MOM) intake
cohort: The cohort consisted of 195 premature infants born and admitted to the NICU at less than 33 weeks gestation between January 2014 and December 2017, who did not have contraindications for receiving mother's own milk.
finding: Infants receiving an exclusive human milk diet (EHM) received colostrum earlier and achieved full mother's own milk (MOM) intake by the second week of life compared to those on a mixed diet.
